==Gameplay==
{{main|Fishing Trawler/Strategies}}
[[File:Fishing Trawler instructions.png|thumb|right|350px|The instructions interface, which can be toggled by speaking to Murphy in Port Khazard.]]

:'''Note:''' It is highly recommended to disable Camera motion by selecting the camera icon next to the contribution bar, as the camera sway can make performing actions during the minigame difficult.

An [[axe]], [[hammer]], a number of [[swamp paste]], several [[rope]]s, and a [[bailing bucket]] are required if participating in all of the activities below. All required items are available in the [[Khazard General Store]]. There are also boxes containing bailing buckets, [[hammer]]s, and [[bronze axe]]s on the top deck of the ship.

During the trip, there are several activities that players can do to help defend and repair Murphy's ship:
* Leaks on the sides of the boat can be repaired using [[swamp paste]]. Leaks can be patched up to 1 tile away. If the leaks are not patched quickly enough, the ship will fill with water, which must be bailed back into the sea with a [[bailing bucket]]'s "bail-with" and "empty" click options.
* The fishing net in the stern occasionally gets torn and must be repaired with [[rope]]. While the net is torn, it will not catch any fish, so it is advisable to fix a ripped net as quickly as possible. Either of the two net halves can be clicked to fix the entire net. The chance to successfully fix the net depends on the player's Crafting level. Failing to do so will result in a message ''"You fail to repair the net in the harsh conditions"''.   
* An [[Enormous_Tentacle_(Fishing Trawler)|enormous tentacle]] from a [[kraken]] will attack the ship's net and railings, slowing down the rate at which fish are caught. Fighting off the tentacle requires an [[axe]] ([[blessed axe]] does '''not''' work), and repairing damage to the ship's railings requires a [[hammer]]. The chance to successfully chop at the kraken's tentacle depends on the axe being used and the player's [[Woodcutting]] level.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1447947558127603718|date=12 Oct 2021|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/TnT36|archivedate=13 Jul 2022|quote=Yes, Woodcutting helps.}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1547302614710231040|date=13 Jul 2022|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220714005634/https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1547302614710231040|archivedate=13 Jul 2022|quote=Yes, in the same way that it would affect your success/failure if you were chopping a basic tree.}}

The amount of leaks, torn nets, and kraken encounters scales with the number of players on the trawler.

===Losing===
The only way to lose is if the water level gets too high before the time is up. The boat will sink, ending the game, and players must climb onto a [[Barrel (Fishing Trawler)|barrel]] to return to shore north of [[Port Khazard]] near fairy ring {{Fairycode|DJP}}. Logging out during a trawl will also return players to this location.

Swimming to shore via the barrel will deal 1-2 damage to the player.

Players can also forfeit by speaking to Murphy and insisting he returns them to shore. This sends the forfeiting player to the barrels as if the boat had sunk, though the game will continue for players remaining on board.
